cloud.title: Sign in to Digital Factory
cloud.description:
Paste an API token. Create one in Digital Factory under [Settings → API Tokens]({api_token_url}).

API tokens need a workspace admin on the Business, Business Plus, Unlimited, Excellence or Campus plan. If the page is missing for you, [upgrade your subscription]({upgrade_url}).

printers.title: Choose printers to import
printers.description: Your workspace has {count} printers. Tick the ones to add to Home Assistant; you can change this later.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Digital Factory again
reauth_confirm.description: Digital Factory no longer accepts the stored API token. Paste a new one from [Settings → API Tokens]({api_token_url}), created in the same workspace.

error.invalid_auth: Digital Factory did not accept this API token
error.incomplete_token: This is not a complete API token. It starts with "umapi-" and ends with "|" and a region, for example "umapi-…|eu". Copy the whole value.

abort.wrong_account: This API token belongs to a different workspace

printers.title: Printers to import
printers.description: Your workspace has {count} printers. Tick the ones to add to Home Assistant; you can change this later.
